Question: I'm married women, my own brother got paralysis. His age is 55. He does not have family. He is undergone treatment. My question is: I'm planning to keep him in our Home to look after him. My Brother's (Patient) right hand is not working. He goes to the Bathroom and do it standing. So, any one has to put the water to get cleaned. Ramzan is coming, if anybody goes to put the water to clean him, will his Roza will be broken or what is the procedure in this case. Also, please let me know the Dua to get well soon from the disease Paralaysis. Our Service Technicians will be more than glad to assist you with resolving the issue. Answer ID: 25214 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1711/1328/B=1431) In the question mentioned above, the person who puts water to get him cleaned his fast will not be nullified, it shall remain intact. Fast is nullified by eating and drinking. You and your brother should recite (يا سلام) extensively in order to be cured. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
